datasets.description: Yemen Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators on a monthly basis throughout 2020 in Yemen. Geographic boundaries were delineated and classified into IPC phases (1-5) representing acute food insecurity severity. The resulting spatial datasets document the geographic extent and intensity of food insecurity as a humanitarian impact indicator.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas.
